description: Uganda's Ministry of Agriculture, Animal Industry and Fisheries publishes its sector statistics through an annual statistical abstract and an online database, the National Food and Agricultural Statistics System. The abstract read here has 53 pages of tables covering 2020 to 2024: agriculture's share of GDP, certified seed supply against requirements, fertiliser use, production of cereals, root crops and oil crops, output and exports of coffee, cotton, tea and cocoa, livestock numbers by type, live animal exports and bee products. A separate livestock abstract is also offered. Both are free to download as PDFs from the ministry's statistics page, which describes the database as providing disaggregated data for farmers, traders, government and researchers. Caveats: the database did not respond when read, so its contents and download options are unverified; the abstract gives national totals in PDF tables; and no licence is stated. Coverage is national. Simulation uses: national production baselines for staple crops in Uganda for food supply and drought impact scenarios. Related records: the WFP global food prices database (data-wfp-global-food-prices) complements these production figures with market prices.
